property_summary: After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the _BASE_RESERVE_ remains unchanged because it is not updated during the fee rate adjustment.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, _BASE_RESERVE_ (accessed via getVaultReserve) stays unchanged from its previous value.
After adjustMtFeeRate, the base reserve read via getVaultReserve reverts to the value read before the call, ignoring any fee base accumulation.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the base reserve (via getVaultReserve) does not change from its value before the call, regardless of any other state changes.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate with some non-zero mtFeeRate, the base reserve _BASE_RESERVE_ remains unchanged because _sync is not called.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the value of _BASE_RESERVE_ should remain unchanged.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate with any valid fee rate, the _BASE_RESERVE_ should remain the same as before the call.
After any call to adjustMtFeeRate(uint256), the base reserve recorded in the contract's public getter must equal the current base token balance minus accumulated base fee.
After a call only to adjustMtFeeRate, the public getters of _BASE_RESERVE_ and _QUOTE_RESERVE_ must remain unchanged.
After adjusting the mtFeeRate to any valid value, the base reserve should reflect the current base token balance minus accumulated base fee.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate with any valid mtFeeRate, _BASE_RESERVE_ remains unchanged.
After adjusting mtFeeRate, _BASE_RESERVE_ remains unchanged (only _MT_FEE_RATE_ changes).
After calling adjustMtFeeRate with any valid mtFeeRate, the value of _BASE_RESERVE_ equals the value of _MT_FEE_BASE_ subtracted from the token balance.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the sum of _BASE_RESERVE_ and _MT_FEE_BASE_ equals the base token balance of the contract.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the base token balance of the contract equals the sum of _BASE_RESERVE_ and _MT_FEE_BASE_.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, _QUOTE_RESERVE_ should remain unchanged from its previous value.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, _QUOTE_RESERVE_ should be equal to _QUOTE_TOKEN_.balanceOf(address(this)) minus _MT_FEE_QUOTE_ (i.e., the correct quote balance after fee withdrawal).
adjustMtFeeRate does not change _QUOTE_RESERVE_ from the value before the call.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the value of _QUOTE_RESERVE_ should equal the contract's current quote token balance minus the accumulated mtFeeQuote.
After adjustMtFeeRate, _QUOTE_RESERVE_ should never equal _BASE_RESERVE_ unless both the quote and base balances happen to be equal.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate with any valid fee rate, the _QUOTE_RESERVE_ state variable (accessed via getVaultReserve()) must be non-zero.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the quote reserve returned by getVaultReserve() must be greater than or equal to the previous quote reserve.
After a call to adjustMtFeeRate, the quote reserve returned by getVaultReserve() must be less than or equal to the total quote token balance (including mt fee) held by the contract.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the sum of BASE_RESERVE and QUOTE_RESERVE (from getVaultReserve()) must be at least as large as the sum of BASE_RESERVE and QUOTE_RESERVE before the call.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, calling getVaultReserve returns a quote reserve that is greater than zero.
After a call to adjustMtFeeRate, the value of _BLOCK_TIMESTAMP_LAST_ is unchanged (i.e., equals its value before the call).
After a call to adjustMtFeeRate, the value of _BLOCK_TIMESTAMP_LAST_ is the current block.timestamp modulo 2^32.
After a call to adjustMtFeeRate, the value of _BLOCK_TIMESTAMP_LAST_ is equal to the block timestamp modulo 2^32 at the time of the call.

After any sequence of public function calls ending with adjustMtFeeRate, the value of _BLOCK_TIMESTAMP_LAST_ is updated to uint32(block.timestamp % 2**32) if the TWAP feature is enabled and reserves are non-zero.
After a call to adjustMtFeeRate, the value of _BLOCK_TIMESTAMP_LAST_ is unchanged (it equals its value before the call) if _IS_OPEN_TWAP_ is false.
The _BASE_TARGET_ value after an adjustMtFeeRate call is always equal to the _BASE_RESERVE_ value when the RState transitions from BELOW_ONE to ONE.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the value of _BASE_TARGET_ never changes.
After any call to adjustMtFeeRate, the value of _BASE_TARGET_ remains unchanged from before the call.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the value of _BASE_TARGET_ is always equal to the previous _BASE_TARGET_ if correctRState does not change _RState_ from BELOW_ONE to ONE, but changes otherwise.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the value of _BASE_TARGET_ is always equal to the value of _BASE_RESERVE_ when _RState_ reflects BELOW_ONE before the call and the final _RState_ is ONE.
After any sequence of buyShares and adjustMtFeeRate calls, _QUOTE_TARGET_ is always monotonic with respect to baseInput (the difference between the actual base balance and the recorded base reserve).
After any sequence of buyShares and adjustMtFeeRate, the ratio _QUOTE_TARGET_ / _BASE_TARGET_ is always at least _I_ (the price) when _BASE_TARGET_ > 0.
After any sequence of buyShares and adjustMtFeeRate calls, the total supply of shares is always equal to the sum of all _SHARES_ balances.
After any sequence of buyShares and adjustMtFeeRate calls, _QUOTE_TARGET_ * totalSupply >= _QUOTE_RESERVE_ * _SHARES_[any user] when totalSupply > 0.
When buying shares with only base input (no quote input), the quote target should not change if it was already equal to the quote reserve before the buy.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate with any uint256 argument, the RState should remain 0 (ONE) if it was originally 0 and the base reserve equals the base target.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate with any uint256 argument, the RState should never become 1 (ABOVE_ONE) when it was originally 0 (ONE) and _BASE_RESERVE_ is less than _BASE_TARGET_.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate with any uint256 argument, the RState should remain unchanged if the current RState is BELOW_ONE and the base reserve is less than the base target.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate with any valid mtFeeRate, the RState should remain unchanged if the current RState is BELOW_ONE and base reserve is less than base target.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, if RState is BELOW_ONE and base reserve is less than base target, then RState should become ONE.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate(), the RState of the contract must remain unchanged from its previous value.
After a call to adjustMtFeeRate() when the RState is BELOW_ONE, the RState must stay BELOW_ONE.
When the RState is BELOW_ONE and BASE_RESERVE is less than BASE_TARGET, calling adjustMtFeeRate should not change the RState from BELOW_ONE.
After any call to adjustMtFeeRate, if the RState was ABOVE_ONE and QUOTE_RESERVE < QUOTE_TARGET before the call, then the RState must remain ABOVE_ONE after the call.
When RState is ABOVE_ONE and QUOTE_RESERVE >= QUOTE_TARGET, calling adjustMtFeeRate does not change RState from ABOVE_ONE.
